assumptions: The operating resistor is ohmic, as permitted by the standard apparatus idealisations.

defect_reasons.contradictory_distractor_statement: Every variant assigns two incompatible resistances to the same disconnected resistor: 47 and 94 Ω, 68 and 136 Ω, 150 and 300 Ω, or 220 and 440 Ω.

notes: The workbench resistor is structurally disconnected (D), so the voltage is 30 V in all four variants regardless of its resistance. Nevertheless, the conflicting reports explicitly concern the same quantity, with no stated correction or physical change resolving them; admission rule 2 therefore makes every rendering invalid. The differing resistance values across legacy variants are parameter changes, not an additional minimal-pair defect.
